subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as an explicit opt-in sandbox config contract for deployments that preinstall skills?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but adding a public config surface and changing sandbox skill materialization behavior is a compatibility-sensitive product boundary choice.

options.title: Accept explicit config after proof
options.body: Keep this PR direction, require current-head Docker/live proof, and merge only after sandbox/config owner review accepts the opt-in contract.

options.title: Move to backend capability
options.body: Ask for sandbox backends to declare this optimization instead of exposing another user-facing core config key.

options.title: Pause core change
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open and pause or close this PR until maintainers settle the sandbox product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit config after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction, require current-head Docker/live proof, and merge only after sandbox/config owner review accepts the opt-in contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their materialized sandbox skill work defines the runtime invariant this opt-out changes.
